topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I just found out my invention, the one I've poured countless hours into, the one I believed could change things, is already patented. The documents are clear, the dates undisputable. I'm not sure what to do now. All the plans, the dreams, they feel like they're slipping away. Maybe I should have checked more thoroughly before, but how was I supposed to know? I need to think this through, figure out if there's any way to still make this work or if I have to start over. The thought of starting from scratch is daunting, but I have to consider it. Right now, I just need some time to process this.
